info.title: Strange Love (ITA)
info.synopsis: Basato sul manga di Oku Hiroya. Yoshida Chizuru è la studentessa più bella della scuola, fa la modella in segreto e appare in vari spot tv, anche se il regolamento scolastico vieta agli studenti di lavorare. Viene scoperta da un'insegnante che pensa bene di ricattarla, ma la ragazza non ha intenzione di farsi mettere nell'angolo...

episodes.title: Volume 1
episodes.synopsis: Two explorations of the Lolita complex. Sushiaki Karasawa, a young teacher at a Tokyo high school, becomes infatuated with Yoshida Chizuru, a 19-year-old student who appears in a shampoo commercial. She realizes he's attracted to her, so she shows up at his apartment and offers to sleep over. Soon he realizes that the games she plays have just begun.

episodes.title: Volume 2
episodes.synopsis: Two explorations of the Lolita complex. Chizuru meets the new neighbor of her rock star boyfriend, Hiroyuki. The girl is Azumi Yamada, an innocent from the provinces who enrolls in Chizuru's school. This time it's Chizuru who's infatuated. What will Hiroyuki do when he finds out he's being thrown over for Azumi? Can Chizuru save her from Hiroyuki's revenge?

info.title: Digimon Frontier
info.synopsis: Anno 2004: il leggendario mondo digitale noto come Digiworld si risveglia, queste sono le avventure dei Digiprescelti. Takuya, Koji, JP, Zoe e Tommy ricevono misteriosi messaggi telefonici che li invitano a prendere un treno particolare: questo mezzo li porterà a Digiworld, dove faranno la conoscenza di due Digimon, Bokomon e Neemon. I due accompagneranno i ragazzi nel loro viaggio, che si dimostrerà presto pericoloso: infatti, i nuovi Digiprescelti dovranno affrontare un esercito di Digimon malvagi determinati a dominare il mondo, ma se nelle serie precedenti gli eroi umani erano affiancati da partner digitali, in questa sono i ragazzi stessi a trasformarsi in Digimon per combattere.

episodes.title: I nuovi Digiprescelti
episodes.synopsis: Kids across the city get strange messages on their electronic devices. These messages ask them if they're ready for their future. What do these messages mean?

episodes.title: Labirinto sotterraneo
episodes.synopsis: With one spirit down, the others prepare for their destiny's, but how does one spirit evolve? Does this mean all the kids will become legendary warriors? And how does spirit evolution work?

episodes.title: Una prova pericolosa
episodes.synopsis: Tomoki wants to learn to spirit evolve, but to get a spirit, he must get through a Candmon village. Can Agnimon help save the day?

episodes.title: La stazione abbandonata
episodes.synopsis: Zoe, JP, Tommy, and Takuya reach a spliting point on the Trailmon tracks. When Takuya and Tommy go one way, it's up to JP and Zoe to save a bunch of Floramon. Can they do so when neither of them has a spirit?

episodes.title: La Fabbrica del Vento
episodes.synopsis: The new digidestined must help a village of Digimon to get free from the Goblimon and Snimon, but can they do so when JP doesn't have a spirit?

episodes.title: La Digievoluzione Slide
episodes.synopsis: The KarautsukiNumemon look for help for their village because legendary warriors have taken their womon and childmon hostage, but when they find out the gang is legendary warriors trouble is the result. What exactly is a Beast Spirit, and why is their now a slide evolution? The answers can be found.

episodes.title: Il Paese dei Balocchi
episodes.synopsis: Takuya's and Koji's differences cause a lot of arguements, but when Tommy gets captured, can they put aside their differences and save him?

episodes.title: Amici in pericolo!
episodes.synopsis: JP and Zoe arrive at a digimon school where one digimon, Tsunomon, is constantly being ignored. Can the two of them convience the other kids that digivolution isn't a bad thing?

episodes.title: L'incubo di Tommy
episodes.synopsis: Tommy is tricked by a Bakumon causing his dreams to all be evil and make his friends appear evil. Can the digi-destined find a way to save him?

episodes.title: Il Digispirit Animale
episodes.synopsis: The digi-destined figure out that you need a Beast Spirit to defeat a Beast Spirit, but can they find there Beast Spirits before Grumblemon steals all of their spirits?

episodes.title: Il villaggio dei veggenti
episodes.synopsis: When Grottemon isolates koji, the others must find a way to defeat his Beast Spirit. Can Shamamon help them out when he's possessed?

episodes.title: Il coraggio di Tommy
episodes.synopsis: Takuya gains control over his beast spirit, but can he maintain that control when he's forced into a one-on-one battle with Grumblemon?

episodes.title: I segreti di Digiworld
episodes.synopsis: 4 of the 5 Dark Warriors decide to attack the digi-destined on a quest to gain their spirits. Can a little help from Sorcermon and Seraphimon help them to free the digital world?

episodes.title: MetalKabuterimon, il guerriero del Tuono
episodes.synopsis: Grumblemon returns to regain his beast spirit and seperates Takuya and Koji from the rest of the group, but when JP gains his beast spirit can he master it enough to finish off Grumblemon for good?

episodes.title: Il villaggio dei Toucanmon
episodes.synopsis: When the gang decodes to go on a water vacation, the Toucanmon steal the boys D-tectors. Can Zoe save the day without her beast spirit?

episodes.title: Il successo di Zoe
episodes.synopsis: A group of Gomamon want to gain access to their island, but it's surronded by whirlpools and Zephrymon guards the way. Can the digi-destined find a way to save the world when the boys still don't have their D-tectors?

episodes.title: Il valore dell'onestà
episodes.synopsis: Tommy finds the boys D-Tectors at the county fair, but he doesn't have anything to trade to get them back. Can he find something to trade to get them back before the Dark Legendary Warriors show up?

episodes.title: Una gara disonesta
episodes.synopsis: The digi-destined stop their battles briefly to participate in the Trailmon races, but can they find a way to stop the normal cheating that occurs?

episodes.title: Cuochi leggendari
episodes.synopsis: The kids need some food, so they head to the Burgermon village. What will happen when they run into the master of wood?

episodes.title: Il Continente Oscuro
episodes.synopsis: Arbormon wants revenge for his missing burgers, so he follows the kids into The Continent of Darkness, but what else has followed there?

episodes.title: Mistero invincibile
episodes.synopsis: When Duskmon proves to be too strong for the digi-destined, they have a new decision to make. What will it be?

episodes.title: Takuya torna a casa
episodes.synopsis: Takuya decides to head home on a Dark Trailmon, but when he gets stuck as a Digimon in the real world, what will he do?

episodes.title: Il potere di un Digimon
episodes.synopsis: Takuya returns to the digital world as a stronger Agunimon, but can he save his friends in a classic 2-on-1 showdown?

episodes.title: Il conflitto di JP
episodes.synopsis: When the kids get sucked inside Sakkakumon, they must defeat their opponents and their own self doubts to get free, but will they succeed?

episodes.title: Il valore dell'amicizia
episodes.synopsis: Tommy gets a group of digimon in his dimension who pretend to be his friend, but can he figure out the truth before they steal his D-Tector?

episodes.title: L'avventura di Zoe
episodes.synopsis: The fight between Ranamon and Zoe reaches its exciting finale, but who will come out the victor?

episodes.title: La Doppia Digievoluzione Spirit
episodes.synopsis: Koji must battle Duskmon one on one, but will he be able to succeed when they couldn't defeat Duskmon as a team?

episodes.title: Takuya contro Mercurymon
episodes.synopsis: To get out of Sakkakumon, Takuya must find a way to defeat Mercurymon. Can he find a way to achieve Fusion Evolution and succeed, or are the digi-destined done for in this battle?

episodes.title: Il potere dell'oscurità
episodes.synopsis: Sakkakumon reveals he is still alive, and now he has the digi-destined's attacks. Can they find a way to create new attacks and defeat Sakkakumon once and for all?

episodes.title: Luce e oscurità
episodes.synopsis: Koji and Kouichi begin to figure out they're related some how, but what is that relation, and can it stop the two of them from destroying each other?

episodes.title: Il cimitero dei Trailmon
episodes.synopsis: JP, Zoe, and Tommy decide to discover what horrors await them at the Rose Morning Star by searching a Trailmon graveyard, but what horrors await them inside the graveyard?

episodes.title: Rivelazioni dal passato
episodes.synopsis: When Koji realizes he has a brother and has been fighting him, he refuses to fight anymore. Can Takuya make him see the truth?

episodes.title: La scelta di Koichi
episodes.synopsis: Now that he's a regular human again, Kouichi decides to join the digi-destined, but can he find a way to help them out without any spirits of his own to use?

episodes.title: L'incontro con Ophanimon
episodes.synopsis: The digidestined decide to free Ophanimon once and for all, but Cherubimon ends up being her guard. Can they find a way to free her from the final of the 3 guardian Digimon?

episodes.title: Il vero Kerpymon
episodes.synopsis: Takuya and Koji must hold off Cherubimon while the others free Ophanimon, but can they succeed when they lose their spirits?

episodes.title: Il combattimento con IceDevimon
episodes.synopsis: Cherubimon appears to be defeated, but he appears to be easy compared to IceDevimon. Can the others find a way to defeat IceDevimon with Takuya and Koji's D-Tectors frozen solid?

episodes.title: La fine di Kerpymon
episodes.synopsis: The final battle between EmperorGreymon/ MagnaGarurumon and Cherubimon begins, but who will end up being the victor, and who are these mysterious characters that are watching the battle?

episodes.title: I Cavalieri Reali
episodes.synopsis: The Royal Knights appears and reveal that Lucemon will return. Can the digi-destined find a way to prevent this chaos from occuring,or will they be delaying the inevitable?

episodes.title: Bloccati sulla luna
episodes.synopsis: After waking up on the moon, the digi-destined decide to try to get back to the digital world to get revenge on the Royal Knights, but will they succeed, or will they be stuck on the moon for the rest of their lives?

episodes.title: Un incontro inatteso
episodes.synopsis: The digidestined run into the same group of kids that pusked Tommy onto the train causing him to come into the digital world, but can Tommy get past his resentment of them and save the day?

episodes.title: Il villaggio del Fagiolo Gigante
episodes.synopsis: Katshuhara and company have been captured by the Royal Knights. It's a good thing for them that Tommy is with them, but can they find a way to save Beanstalk Village, and can the other kids get Worm the Trailmon to want to help out?

episodes.title: Salvate le Digiuova!
episodes.synopsis: When the Royal Knights target the Village og Beginnings for their next assault, it's up to the kids to convience the Trailmon to save the digi-eggs, but can they finally defeat the Royal Knights? Maybe they can with help from some old enemies.

episodes.title: Scontro alla Città del Fuoco
episodes.synopsis: The kids rush to try and save the Flame Terminal from being deleted, but with the SkullSatamon already on hand, can they find a way to defeat them? Is there any way to unite all the Digimon to fight together?

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Gotsumon
episodes.synopsis: With only 3 areas left to protect in the digital world, the digi-destined must act fast to save the forest terminal. EmperorGreymon and MagnaGarurumon seem to be getting stronger, but will they finally be able to defeat the Royal Knights?

episodes.title: Alla difesa dell'Elettromercato di Akiba
episodes.synopsis: Only 2 areas of the digital world remain: The Autumn Leaf Fair and Ophanimon's castle, but can the kids find a way to save The Fair without losing any more digimon friends, or is the digital world truly done for?

episodes.title: Lucemon si rivela
episodes.synopsis: The digi-destined arrive at Ophanimon's castle to try and save the last bit of data from being given to Lucemon. Can they finally defeat the Royal Knights, or will Lucemon be reborn?

episodes.title: Il destino dei Cavalieri Reali
episodes.synopsis: The final battle with the Royal Knights is about to occur, but who will win this surprising bout?

episodes.title: Il sacrificio di Koichi
episodes.synopsis: Since Emperor Greymon and MagnaGarurumon proved to be too weak, the kids decide to try a multi attack, but will it be enough, or will they need additional power?

episodes.title: Pericolo sulla Terra
episodes.synopsis: Susannomon has been born, but will the combined powers of all 10 legendary spirits be enough to defeat Lucemon for good, or does Lucemon have one final surprise in store?

episodes.title: La vittoria finale
episodes.synopsis: The final battle between Lucemon and Susanoomon will be decided not in the digital world, but in the real world. Who will end up prevailing in this free for all?

episodes.title: Risolutezza
episodes.synopsis: Le Cappe Bianche cospirano per far arrestare il capitano Obi. Mentre Shinra e gli altri si prendono una pausa, suona l'allarme. I soldati interrompono il rapporto di Obi al capo dei vigili del fuoco.

episodes.title: Il prigioniero
episodes.synopsis: L'8ª Brigata decide di ribellarsi e fare squadra con un vecchio avversario.

episodes.title: L'incarnazione delle fiamme
episodes.synopsis: L'8ª Brigata decide di dare l'assalto al carcere imperiale per liberare il capitano Obi.

episodes.title: Segreto dorato
episodes.synopsis: L'Ottava Brigata lotta per trovare un modo per contrastare i poteri di Gold. E poi, qualcuno di inaspettato si fa avanti per combattere.

episodes.title: Incontro con l'arcinemico
episodes.synopsis: Arthur affronta il nemico che ha sempre desiderato, Dragon.

episodes.title: Il risultato delle preghiere
episodes.synopsis: La battaglia tra Shinra e Burns continua. I sentimenti di un eroe si scontrano con la volontà di un servitore di Sol. Chi vincerà?

episodes.title: Verità sopita
episodes.synopsis: Hibana, Karim e Huo Yan si recano alle rovine del convento San Raffles per investigare.

episodes.title: La Santa Madre oscura
episodes.synopsis: Mentre Hibana e gli altri continuano le loro indagini al convento di St. Raffles, appare qualcuno di inaspettato.

episodes.title: La rinascita della sacra spada
episodes.synopsis: Arthur conduce il gruppo in un territorio inaspettato alla ricerca del metallo per riforgiare Excalibur.

episodes.title: Avvento
episodes.synopsis: Dopo un'occhiata attraverso un Adra Link, Sho decide di vedere suo fratello ancora una volta prima della Grande catastrofe.

episodes.title: Battaglia contro il kaiju
episodes.synopsis: La Grande catastrofe viene messa in moto. Un gigantesco pilastro appare nel Pacifico. Shinra chiede di essere inviato sul posto, ma...

episodes.title: Antica follia
episodes.synopsis: Faerie cattura uno Shinra privo di sensi. Sho appare e attacca. Shinra riceve un consiglio da una fonte sorprendente.

info.title: Lamù - Sei sempre il mio tesoruccio
info.synopsis: Lupika è una principessa aliena che intende ottenere un filtro d'amore per conquistare un uomo di cui si è invaghita. Tuttavia, l'unico che può avere questa pozione è l'uomo più depravato del pianeta, che si scopre essere proprio Ataru Moroboshi. Pertanto, Lupika decide di rapire Ataru, fatto che ovviamente non può lasciare indifferente Lamù, che cercherà di salvare il suo amato.

episodes.title: Il terrore degli occhioni
episodes.synopsis: Ten ha preso una malattia molto contagiosa: il morbillo dagli occhioni femminei, che trasforma lo sguardo degli ammalati in quello dolce e con grandi occhi tipico delle fanciulle. La malattia, che colpisce solo i maschi, si cura facilmente: una iniezione e tre giorni di riposo assoluto. Ten contagia Ataru: entrambi vengono curati da Lamù, ma Ataru non ne vuole sapere di stare a riposo e se ne va in giro per la città diffondendo il virus.

info.title: Di Gi Charat: Winter Garden
info.synopsis: Sono passati dieci anni dagli eventi della serie principale. Dejiko ora è una giovane cameriera di vent'anni che lavora in una pasticceria mentre Puchiko ha quindici anni e frequenta la scuola. Il giorno di Natale Dejiko incontra per strada Takuro Senba. La ragazza stava portando la torta di compleanno alla sorella ma cade rovinando così la torta. Takuro dispiaciuto e intenerito decide di regalarle la sua. Dejiko si innamora di Takuro e questo sconvolgerà la vita quotidiana di entrambe le ragazze.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: ケーキ屋さんでアルバイトをするデ・ジ・キャラットこと、でじこは妹・ぷちことふたり暮らしをしている。雪の降りしきるクリスマスの日、バイトの帰り道でひとりの青年と出会い、恋心を抱くのだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: でじこは拓郎と偶然何度が出会ううちに、親密さを増していった。一方ぷちこは、ソフトボール部を辞めて、アルバイトを始める。そんなある日、でじこはバイト仲間から拓郎がほかの女性と一緒にいたと聞き…。

info.title: Usaru-san
info.synopsis: Il franchise del personaggio mascotte di Media Factory ruota attorno a un coniglio maschio che si trasforma in Usaru-san indossando un costume da scimmia e mangiando banane. Il titolo “Usaru-san” è un portmanteau di “usagi” (coniglio) e “saru” (scimmia).

episodes.title: This Summer, Plenty of Breasts
episodes.synopsis: Naeka, Kosuke, Eiko, Miwa, Kogarashi and Fubuki go on a vacation to a deserted beach island to relax. However, relaxation is the last thing they get when they awaken the ancient immortal spirit of a fisherman who is obsessed with breasts and plans to kidnap Naeka, Eiko, Miwa and Fubuki to hypnotize them and turn them into his big boobed slaves.

info.title: Love Hina Christmas Movie
info.synopsis: Mentre si avvicinano nuovi esami preliminari per Keitaro, arriva anche il Natale. Si dice che, essendo la prima vigilia di Natale del millennio, se qualcuno confesserà il proprio amore in questa serata speciale, il suo desiderio si avvererà. Keitaro ha deciso cosa fare quella vigilia: confessare il suo amore a Naru. Ma uno studente ripetente come lui può permettersi di distogliere l'attenzione dagli esami proprio quel giorno? E soprattutto, non sarà l'unico a confessarsi quella notte...

episodes.title: Love Hina Special Christmas
episodes.synopsis: Gli esami sono vicini e i nostri Ronins sono immersi nello studio mentre il Natale si avvicina. Una leggenda dice che se una persona si dichiara per la Vigilia di Natale, potrà vivere felicemente con la persona che ama. In un clima natalizio, sorretto come sempre da splendide animazioni ambientate in una città decorata e grazie ad una e sempre fantastica colonna sonora, Keitaro e Naru vivono questa nuova avventura che segnerà un passo decisivo nel loro rapporto.

info.title: Pretty Cure All Stars New Stage – Il film: Amici del futuro
info.synopsis: A Yokohama riappare Fusion e le Leggendarie Guerriere ancora una volta si riuniscono per sconfiggerlo, ma il nemico si divide in tante piccole parti sparse per la città. Intanto, in seguito ai film DX, i combattimenti delle Pretty Cure hanno impressionato i cittadini di Mirai, inclusa Ayumi Sakagami, una ragazza introversa appena trasferitasi alla scuola locale. Sulla via del ritorno da scuola, Ayumi incontra una piccola creatura, che a sua insaputa è in realtà un frammento di Fusion, e decide di chiamarlo “Fu-chan” e diventare sua amica..

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: In order to gain some privacy for Pretty Cure, the girls attempt to locate the perfect base. But after having trouble agreeing on each others ideas, the girls attempt to find a way to unify the team.

info.title: Gnosia
info.synopsis: Le Gnosia mentono. Fingendo di essere umane, stermineranno tutti gli abitanti dell'universo, uno alla volta. L'equipaggio di un'astronave alla deriva, minacciato dalle letali "Gnosia" e senza avere idea di chi sia il vero nemico, escogita un disperato piano per sopravvivere. I membri più sospetti verranno messi in animazione sospesa, uno alla volta, per tentare di eliminare le Gnosia dall'astronave. Tuttavia, è quasi impossibile capire se le persone in animazione sospesa siano davvero delle Gnosia o dei semplici capri espiatori, sacrificati dalle Gnosia per assicurarsi la sopravvivenza. Riusciranno gli umani a trionfare? O sarà l'inizio della fine per l'umanità?

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Yuri, who has lost their memory, wakes up aboard the Interstellar Cruiser D.Q.O. They are taken by Setsu to participate in a meeting to identify the "Gnosia," a being that attacks and annihilates humans.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Yuri, who looped back to the first day, attends the meeting knowing who the Gnosia is. Yuri tries to cast suspicion on SQ, but the discussion doesn't progress as expected...?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Shigemichi and Stella join the group, and a meeting is held with seven people. During the meeting, Yuri uses their intuition to identify the Gnosia, but they struggle to convince the other crew members.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Despite identifying the Gnosia and surviving, Yuri finds themself back at the first day in a daze, when a person with an unusual presence, Yuriko, appears before them. She seems to know something, but...?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: New crew members Comet and Chipie join the meeting. Two of the crew claim to be engineers, but Racio argues against voting for them, resulting in the votes going to...?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Yuri attends the meeting in a new role as the "Guardian Angel." With Jonas and Kukrushka joining, the meeting now has 13 people, and as the situation becomes chaotic, one crew member raises their hand.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Otome and Remnan join in and the meeting is about to begin, but the other new crew member, Sha-Ming, refuses to come out of his room. Meanwhile, Shigemichi begins to talk about his feelings for Stella.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Remnan and Kukrushka step forward as "Guard Duty," a role that confirms they are human. As the number of positions increases and the meeting becomes more complicated, Sha-Ming, who is suspected by Kukrushka, takes a certain action...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Yuri awakens as a Gnosia. Though they feel hesitant about deceiving their fellow crew members, they are touched by the feelings of Comet, who shares their position, and resolve to fulfill their role as promised to Setsu.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Yuri, who has looped once again, is astonished by their new appearance. Amidst this, the meeting is postponed due to Sha-Ming's absence, and Raqio reveals the secret of the Silver Key to the bewildered Yuri.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Upon waking up, Yuri finds themself in a loop where they and SQ are on Guard Duty. Knowing that they are both human, the two grow closer, and eventually SQ reveals her true "identity"—.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Gina, who intensely dislikes lying and deceiving others, is confided in about the loops by Yuri. Recalling a painful past, she expresses her fears and resistance toward becoming a Gnosia.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: Before the meeting, Setsu loses consciousness and is taken to the Sickbay. As they share the information they have acquired, Yuri suggests that Setsu, who appears exhausted from having repeated hundreds of loops, take a break. The "Truth Arc" begins...

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: "If you survive this loop, I'll tell you everything." Yuri, presented with a condition by Yuriko, attends a meeting where all 15 crew members are gathered. However, once the meeting begins, an unexpected proposal comes from Yuriko.

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: Raqio, who was identified as a Gnosia by the Engineer, Yuri, claims innocence based on a certain action. The emergence of an AC Follower throws the meeting into chaos, and Yuri is cornered.

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: When Yuri awakens, it's in a world line where the ship has escaped Gnosia contamination. As Yuri is bewildered by Kukrushka's implication of "the end of the universe," an alarm blares detecting an abnormal biological reaction.

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: Yuri learns the truth: that they are a "Bug" that shouldn't exist. They struggle to escape the time loop and the cosmic collapse caused by their dual existence, but...?

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: Yuri awakens on "DAY 0," the day before the loop they always experience and before escaping Liu-An. They meet Setsu there, but Setsu seems unaware of the Silver Key or the loops...

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: Yuri has escaped the loop, but the crew members have lost all memory of Setsu. On the planet where they land, Yuri follows Setsu's traces, only to be confronted with the harsh fact that Setsu's very existence has vanished.

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: In order to end Setsu's loop, Yuri obtains Raqio's "Silver Key." As Yuri tries to host the key once again, Raqio calls out to them.

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: Yuri reunites with Setsu on the other side of the dimensional door. They find themselves in the world line before they received the Silver Key that first awakened them. And so, their final discussion begins――

info.title: One Piece: Le avventure del detective Cappello di Paglia
info.synopsis: In una terra lontana chiamata Grande Zipangu è primavera. La banda di malviventi capitanati da Bagy attacca l'agenzia di cambio gestita da Ipponmatsu. In quello stesso momento Rufy sta mangiando al ristorante gestito da Nami e paga con dei soldi requisiti a dei falsari, ignaro che si tratta appunto di denaro contraffatto. Usop lo raggiunge e lo informa che il gruppo di Bagy è arrivato in città e sta seminando il caos. Rufy allora decide di andare ad arrestarli...

info.title: Monster Strike: Deadverse Reloaded
info.synopsis:
Rinne è una ragazza che non riesce a vedere i volti delle altre persone. Nata in una famiglia il cui lavoro è quello di esorcizzare esseri soprannaturali, parte per la sua prima missione, ma incontra un nemico di natura diversa da quella che si aspettava e si ritrova in pericolo.

Dopo essere stata salvata da un uomo misterioso di nome Jugemu, Rinne scopre che tutti i mondi, compreso quello in cui vive, noto come “Strike Worlds”, sono in pericolo.

Mentre viaggia attraverso una serie di mondi in via di estinzione con Jugemu, la ragazza stringe un legame con lui...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Rinne, a girl who cannot see faces and is from a family of exorcists, heads to her first mission with the power of the storm god, Yakumo. They defeat a series of specters, but face an unforeseen monster with black crystals and infinite regeneration. As their situation becomes critical, the mysterious man, Jugemu, saves them.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Jugemu, who possesses the power to destroy the regenerating monsters, is supported in battle by a woman named Neo. Rinne questions them about their identities, the monsters' true nature, and the "Master Orb" that Jugemu mentioned, but the two give no answers. The next day, however, Rinne notices that Jugemu is tailing her on school premises.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: After Jugemu and his allies defeat a horde of monsters known as "core holders" who were attacking the city, a new swarm appears, accompanied by a masked man who targets Rinne's estate. Jugemu and the others move to intercept, but they are overwhelmed by the immense power of the Ruinous-class monster Shuringala, summoned by the masked man. The man then reaches for Rinne...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Rinne's world begins to collapse after the Masked Man (World User) steals half of the Master Orb. Determined to retrieve it, Rinne pursues the World User to another world facing destruction. There, Rinne and her allies encounter Masamune, a girl who calls herself a "Protective Sword" (Gotō).」

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Leaving Masamune's world, the group travels to another world whose Master Orb was stolen. They arrive at a battlefield where the revolutionary army, led by the military genius Kirinji, fights an army of grotesque "Core Beasts." The team offers to fight alongside Kirinji's forces. Amidst the conflict, Yakumo notices a heavy burden that Rinne is secretly grappling with.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: A signal from the World Reavers resurfaces in Neo's world-a world that has already lost its Master Orb. Its source is a massive structure drifting in space. It's an enormous core holder plummeting toward the planet! To prevent it from crashing into the surface, Neo and the others launch into space, infiltrate the core holder's interior, and begin a desperate mission to destroy the core!

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The masked man shatters the barrier protecting the White Archive and a massive army of core holders pours inside. His goal is the Primordial Orb, said to be sealed in the deepest chamber of the Archive. With Jugemu absent, the one who stands in the World Reaver's way is the guardian deity of Strike Island-Godstriker.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: The Primordial Orb falls into the hands of the World Reaver Anger. Ominous dark clouds spread over Strike Island. However, Jugemu, now empowered with new strength, defeats the Ruinous-class monster Kakagosedec and corners Anger. Seizing a brief opportunity to escape, Anger absorbs the power of Caliente Volcano in order to eliminate the IrregularsI

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: After transforming into a flame monster, Anger is finally defeated by Jugemu. But suddenly, another World Reaver appears and cuts Jugemu in half. Witnessing this, Rinne awakens, and her spirit gun unleashes a massive blast of light that hurtles toward the World Reaver!

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Having reclaimed the Master Orb from the World Reaver Nowhere, Rinne awakens to her true power. But Nowhere, too, transforms into a terrifying monster, declaring that he "won't look at what doesn't need to be seen" as he attacks with overwhelming might. Yet within Rinne burns with the strength of all the bonds she has forged... The final battle between Rinne and Nowhere begins.

info.title: One Piece: Episode of Luffy - Avventura su Hand Island
info.synopsis: Viaggiando per il Nuovo Mondo, la ciurma di Cappello di paglia viene attaccata dalla Marina e per sfuggire a una palla di cannone gigante finisce su Hand Island, un'isola abitata da mastri artigiani. Mentre i suoi compagni cercano un modo per raddrizzare la nave e lasciare l'isola, Rufy fa la conoscenza di Diego, un artigiano della cera che ammira i pirati e il loro stile di vita libero.

info.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess (ITA)
info.synopsis: Nel palazzo di Hina vengono riunite le principesse di cinque famiglie per formare la nuova generazione di imperatrici. Reirin, una ragazza fragile ma dalla grande bellezza, si ritrova nel corpo di un'altra pretendente al trono, la gelosa Keigetsu. Nessuno crede a Reirin, che nel corpo di Keigetsu si ritrova improvvisamente odiata da tutti e chiamata “principessa ratto”. Ma nonostante tutto, questa situazione non farà altro che rendere la giovane ancora più determinata!

episodes.title: Una pessima cattiva
episodes.synopsis: Cinque nobili casate risiedono nei Quartieri delle dame, una sezione della corte interna del Regno di Ei. Reirin, la dama della casata dei Kou, è la favorita del principe ereditario Gyoumei, grazie alla bellezza e alle qualità eccezionali. All'opposto, Keigetsu, dama della casata degli Shu, ha fama di essere malvagia ed è odiata da tutti a corte. Alla Festa del doppio sette, Keigetsu usa la magia proibita per scambiare il suo corpo con quello di Reirin. Quando "Reirin" si sveglia, Keigetsu è condannata a morte. Nonostante il pericolo imminente, la ragazza, da sempre cagionevole, è felice di trovarsi in un corpo così sano...

episodes.title: Dovrò vivere qui?
episodes.synopsis: A seguito del trambusto nella corte interna, la consorte imperiale Shu ordina a Reirin di cambiare residenza, mandandola sostanzialmente in esilio. Poiché la nuova sistemazione è praticamente un magazzino abbandonato, Leelee l'ancella personale di Keigetsu, sfoga tutta la frustrazione accumulata fino a quel momento. Dopo aver gridato contro Reirin, Leelee le dice che non è disposta a prendersi cura di lei e se ne va. Reirin rimane sola, piena di gioia per la sua nuova libertà...

episodes.title: Testa alta, schiena dritta
episodes.synopsis: Sono passati quattro giorni dallo scambio di corpi. Reirin, bandita in un capanno all'interno del Palazzo Shu, si dedica al giardinaggio grazie al corpo in buona salute di Keigetsu. Godendo di una nuova libertà in cui non è costretta ad affidarsi agli altri, Reirin prova finalmente un senso di soddisfazione. Nel frattempo, Leelee viene spinta da Gayou, un'ancella di alto rango della casata Kin, a tormentare Reirin...

episodes.title: La mia cometa miracolosa
episodes.synopsis: Keigetsu, suffering from a severe fever, controls a flame to seek help from Reirin. Reirin feels heartbroken seeing Keigetsu managing to calm herself down. Reirin suggests the cancellation of the swap, but the request is rejected. For the upcoming Ghost Festival ritual, Reirin presents Leelee with a garment she had sewn just for Leelee. Meanwhile, Leelee feels that something is off from a certain phrase Reirin unintentionally uttered.

episodes.title: Chi è quella ragazza?
episodes.synopsis: To settle the score with Gayou who enticed Leelee into harassment, Reirin takes Leelee in tow and heads to the Ghost Festival ritual. Not flinching that a seat was not prepared for her, Reirin wearing a handmade garment with beautiful embroidery stands dignified in the hall. In due time, the offerings of dances by the Maidens begin. Seika of the Kin clan who is hosting the ritual dances brilliantly...

episodes.title: Non vi lascerò morire
episodes.synopsis: Reirin finds it suspicious that Seika said there is no one named Gayou in the Kin clan. Just when she was about to ask for details, the Kou clan court lady Tousetsu comes in with a notice that "Reirin's" life is in danger! Reirin wishes to save "Reirin's" life, but Gyoumei refuses the offer, saying he doesn't trust her. However, the empress Kou Kenshuu tells Reirin that nursing will be allowed if she can show her sincerity by drawing the Bow of Warding all night long.

episodes.title: Sapete perché voglio regalarvi un'anima?
episodes.synopsis: After drawing the Bow of Warding continuously, Reirin falls unconscious. Reirin awakens to see Tousetsu, who has caught onto the swapping of the Maidens. Around the same time, Keigetsu realizes that a curse was placed on a gift given to her. Meanwhile, at the Maiden Court, a tea party is being held in celebration of "Reirin's" recovery. There, Kenshuu reminisces about her days as a Maiden that she spent together with Shu Gabi, the Noble Consort.

episodes.title: Comportati da cattiva!
episodes.synopsis: Keigetsu realizes that the cause of her illness is a curse created by venomcraft, and has an idea who placed such a curse... Visitation gifts from Seika makes Reirin hypothesize that someone is scheming to make it seem as though the harassment was done by the Kin clan. Worried about Keigetsu, Reirin speaks to a flame. Keigetsu appears in the flame as if to answer that call. But then, Keigetsu asks Reirin for help...

episodes.title: Vi salverò a tutti i costi
episodes.synopsis: Reirin realizes that Kenshuu's agony is that of a curse, which gives her an understanding of Gabi's true objective. Reirin asks Gyoumei if she can borrow the Bow of Warding once more, but he will not heed her request. Unable to give up, Reirin heads over alone to see Keigetsu and have the swap cancelled. Right as she passes by Gyoumei, a certain image catches his eye...

episodes.title: Condivideremo la maledizione
episodes.synopsis: Gyoumei realizes the swap between Reirin and Keigetsu and heads over to the Kou Palace in pursuit of Reirin. Tousetsu is inquired about the circumstances by Gyoumei but cannot divulge the truth because of her promise with Reirin. Gyoumei gets the hint from Tousetsu's behavior and shows his resolve by voluntarily removing his crown. Meanwhile, Reirin heads back to the Shu Palace with Keigetsu in tow to deal with the curse...

episodes.title: Una cattiva coi fiocchi
episodes.synopsis: With the plans to murder Kenshuu using a curse out in the open, Gabi is cornered. She tries to slash Reirin, but is pinned down on the spot. With everything settled, Reirin and Keigetsu decide to cancel the swap. As they are enveloped in flames, the two Maidens tell each other how they feel...

info.title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan
info.synopsis: Kurumi Fukuga è una studentessa universitaria di 20 anni segnata da un evento traumatico del suo passato. Anni prima, sua madre si era avvicinata al mondo del trading Forex (FX) nella speranza di guadagnare facilmente, ma una grave crisi finanziaria e decisioni sbagliate la portarono ad accumulare un debito enorme. Schiacciata dalla vergogna e dalla disperazione, la donna si tolse la vita, lasciando Kurumi con un profondo senso di colpa e rimpianto. Decisa a dare un significato a quella tragedia, Kurumi sceglie di affrontare lo stesso mondo che ha distrutto la sua famiglia: il mercato FX. Il suo obiettivo è chiaro e ossessivo, recuperare i 20 milioni di yen perduti dalla madre. Tra grafici, operazioni rischiose e continui sbalzi emotivi, Kurumi scopre quanto il trading possa essere crudele e psicologicamente logorante.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Kurumi enters the world of forex to prove she can succeed where her mother once failed.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After some advice from her friend Mochiko, Kurumi takes a risky position trading the Australian dollar.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
